question: If (cos alpha)/(sin β) = 10 and (cos alpha)/(cos β) = 11, then the value of cos²β is:
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9a0d193a610faeb288570775215e68c3ca19196c200bb35f2fc4fb3fe0e6291.png] 

(cos α)/(sin β) = 10 , (cos α)/(cos β) = 11

**Calculation:**

10 sinβ = 11 cosβ

⇒ tanβ = 11/10

cos²β = 100/221
